pageCache.text:
Striving for Excellence Together
Welcome to the Website
I am delighted to welcome you to the Sir William Romney’s School and our website. It is my privilege to be the Headteacher of this wonderful school which serves Tetbury and surrounding areas and is a proud member of the Athelstan Trust.
At Sir William Romney’s School our purpose of “Striving for Excellence Together” drives us and our values of aspiration, collaboration and resilience define us.
We are ambitious for every member of our school community to achieve more than they ever thought possible. Everyone is encouraged to strive towards aspiration goals, daring to dream whilst developing the resilience needed to keep on going when setbacks to this journey inevitably occur. We champion each other to have the courage to take risks and embrace opportunities both inside and outside of the classroom so we can grow our character.
Our school is a happy and purposeful culture striving for every person to feel a sense of belonging because they feel safe, are proud to be a member of the school and are valued for the contribution they make towards its success. We value the importance of all our stakeholders including students, staff, parents/carers, Governors and the local community because working together leads to greater success, innovation and satisfaction. Our differences are celebrated and embraced whilst we recognise that kindness can propel us forward, both as individuals and as a community.
Don’t just take my word for it. We are always open to visitors coming to see what we do at Sir William Romney. Just give us a call and we will arrange your visit.
I look forward to meeting you very soon.
Welcome to the Athelstan Trust. We are a Multi-Academy Trust of ten schools in Wiltshire, Gloucestershire and South Gloucestershire. We were established in 2015 and we are responsible for the education of over four thousand students. The Athelstan Trust aims to achieve the best for, and from, each child. We intend to enable each child to realise their full academic, creative and physical potential and to develop positive social and moral values.
For more information please contact us

pageCache.text:
Headteacher’s Welcome
Welcome to Sir William Romney’s School
It is my great pleasure to welcome you to Sir William Romney’s School and to our website. As Headteacher of this wonderful school, serving Tetbury and its surrounding areas as a proud member of the Athelstan Trust, I am honoured to share our vision and values with you.
At Sir William Romney’s, our guiding purpose, “Striving for Excellence Together,” is at the heart of everything we do. Our core values—aspiration, collaboration, and resilience—shape our identity and drive our achievements.
We are committed to nurturing ambition in every member of our school community, inspiring them to reach beyond what they thought possible. We encourage everyone to dream big while fostering the resilience needed to overcome challenges along the way. We also emphasise the importance of courage—encouraging students to take risks and embrace opportunities both in and out of the classroom to grow their character.
Our school culture is both happy and purposeful, built on a strong sense of belonging. Every individual is valued for their unique contributions, and we strive to ensure that all members of our community feel safe, proud, and supported. Collaboration is key to our success; by working together with students, staff, parents/carers, Governors, and the local community, we achieve greater outcomes, foster innovation, and strengthen our collective satisfaction
At Sir William Romney’s, we celebrate diversity and recognise that kindness is a powerful force for growth—both as individuals and as a community.
But don’t just take my word for it! We are always open for you to come and visit us and experience our vibrant community in action. Simply give us a call, and we’ll be delighted to arrange your visit.
For more information please contact us

pageCache.pageTitle: Vision, Purpose and Values – Sir William Romney’s School
pageCache.text:
Vision, Purpose and Values
SWR will be a beacon of excellence admired in Gloucestershire and beyond
Striving for Excellence Together
What does Striving for Excellence Together mean?
To move purposefully towards aspirational goals, dare to dream and to keep on going when setbacks to this journey occur.
To have a happy and purposeful culture where every individual feels a sense of belonging because they feel safe, are proud to be a member of the school and are valued for the contribution they make towards its success.
To take risks and have a thirst to improve so we all embrace opportunities to grow our character developing the lifelong habits of leadership, organisation, resilience, initiative and communication.
To aspire and achieve the capital of exceptional outcomes both academically and in character development that is greater than we ever thought possible and is needed for future opportunities and happiness in later life.
Greater success, innovation and satisfaction will be achieved when all our stakeholders including students, staff, parents, Governors and the local community work positively together. We all celebrate and embrace our differences and recognise that kindness can propel us forward, both as individuals and as a community.
For more information please contact us

pageCache.text:
DT Food Preparation and Nutrition
Head of Design & Technology: Mrs K Cropley (k.cropley@swr.gloucs.sch.uk)
The Design Technology and Food Preparation & Nutrition Curriculum at Sir William Romney’s School aims to provide all students, no matter their background or starting point, the opportunity to learn new skills in a variety of ways. In this way, our hope is to broaden our student’s horizons and to help them to see and reach their true potential. All students have equal opportunity to study all aspects of Design Technology and Food Preparation & Nutrition throughout their time at Sir William Romney’s. The skills learned by our students will enable them to access a wide range of Post 16 courses or careers in many different sectors. Our aim is to make the routes to these opportunities clear and achievable. As well as this, we strive to develop a range of personal and life skills such as teamwork, problem solving and creativity that will enable our students to become confident, independent, and valuable members of society.

French
Head of Modern Foreign Languages: Miss S Nicholls (snicholls@swr.gloucs.sch.uk)
“Spread your wings, you will have no idea how far you can fly”
Imagine living in a world where you can only speak to 1 in every 21 people or a world where everyone looks the same way, acts the same way, likes the same things. In MFL we promote a love of learning and curiosity, exposing learners to new countries, cultures, and languages. Learning another language develops literacy and oracy in both the target language and English, preparing students to succeed in a globalised society. We believe that language lessons, trips and extracurricular activities will broaden students’ horizons beyond familiar cultural boundaries – raising aspirations, developing collaborative skills, and creating resilient young adults.

pageCache.pageTitle: Parent/Carer’s Evening – Sir William Romney’s School
pageCache.text:
Parent/Carer’s Evening
Some of our Parents/Carers’ Evenings are managed and administered via an online system https://sirwilliamromneys.schoolcloud.co.uk/ . This system allows parents/carers to choose and book their own appointments, subject to availability, at times which are convenient to them via a video conference link.
Please note the following important information:
Prior to each evening, the online system will be opened to parents/carers for booking appointments for a time window of one week. This time window will be specified on the invitation letter that will be sent to the parents/carers of all students of the relevant year group, in advance of the evening. Invitation letters will also be made available.
A short guide on using the online booking system to add appointments is available below.
A guide on how to attend and book appointments over video call is accessible below.
For the Parents/Carers’ Evening process to function smoothly, it is imperative that the school has been provided with an accurate, current email address for the parents/carers of each student. If you need to update us with an email address, please email admin@swr.gloucs.sch.uk
If you do not have access to the internet, or have any questions, please contact the school.
